messages:
maya: Quick sync — we're lining up a joint announcement + marketplace listing + SI bundle for an open model (Aurora). Need clarity on redistribution, attribution, and export controls before we publish. Who should own the licensing convo?

lucas: I can take point on the licensing side. Need to know the exact weights license the provider wants (CC-BY, Apache, dual, custom). Also flagging export control questions if there are specialized components. Can someone drop the model's license text? @olivia? :eyes:

olivia: Copy — provider sent two artifacts: license.txt and distro_terms.pdf. Uploading to drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/aurora-onboard (private). Main asks: marketplace SKUs (hosted vs dedicated), allowed redistributions to downstream SIs, and co-branding language.

maya: Added a short checklist in the drive. High level priorities: 1) confirm redistribution rights, 2) marketplace listing copy, 3) embargo window for joint press, 4) HW partner bundle terms.

lucas: Draft note on redistribution (very rough):
```text
- Provider grants non-exclusive rights to redistribute quantified model weights for commercial use.
- Redistribution allowed to channel partners & SIs when used as part of Redwood-hosted or dedicated offerings.
- No sublicensing of raw weights unless explicit written consent.
- Attribution required in UI and marketplace listing.
```
Will iterate with provider legal. Need to verify if provider needs escrow or escrowing is optional.

sam: Ops question — if we allow SI redistribution, do we still require customers to route inference through Redwood (e.g., hosted/dedicated) or can SIs rehost? That affects our infra and SLA language.

olivia: Product preference is: allow redistribution only as integrated bundles where Redwood runtime or API is used (keeps metrics + billing + quality checks). If partner insists on rehosting, we should require a "validated runtime" checklist and a signed redistribution addendum.

maya: Noted. @lucas, can you confirm if that restriction is enforceable contractually? We need enforcement language for audit and metrics.

lucas: Yes, enforceable with contractual controls and right-to-audit clause. But provider may push back — some open licenses (e.g., Apache) don't let you add usage restrictions. If provider chooses permissive open license, we might rely on commercial addendum with the provider or offer a separate redistribution license to SIs.

olivia: For marketplace listing copy, here's a short blurb draft: "Aurora — community-trained 13B model optimized for production inference. Available on Redwood Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. See redistribution & enterprise bundles for SI integrations." Thoughts?

maya: Looks good. Add a note to include attribution footer and link to provider repo.

dev-bot: file uploaded: /legal/aurora/draft_redistribution_addendum_v1.pdf (checksum: abc123). :white_check_mark:

sam: On HW partner bundling — if we bundle with HW vendor (EdgeBox), need to check their image licensing and whether we can preinstall weights for SI distribution. I'll ping EdgeBox.

lucas: Two action items for me: 1) run license compatibility check between provider license + our redistribution addendum, 2) draft right-to-audit + attribution clauses. ETA EOD Thu.

olivia: I'll prepare SKU matrix: hosted / dedicated / private + SI bundle options + pricing placeholders. Sharing by tomorrow.

maya: Great. Let's hold a quick 30-min sync Fri 10am PT to confirm final phrasing and embargo window. If legal signs off sooner we can lock marketplace publish date.

sam: I'll confirm EdgeBox constraints before the sync and post any blockers here.

lucas: FYI — if provider insists on Apache-style permissive license, recommending two-track: marketplace listing for hosted + a paid redistribution license for SIs. Will outline pros/cons in my draft.

maya: Thanks all — documenting owners in the drive. Ping me if anything urgent. :thumbsup:
